parts.desc: 从这里开始是冲突区，HEAD 指你当前所在分支的版本
parts.desc_en: Starting here is the conflict area, HEAD refers to the version of the branch you are currently on.

parts.desc: 当前分支上这行长什么样，通常是 main 主线的内容
parts.desc_en: What does this line look like on the current branch? It is usually the content of the main line.

parts.desc: 上下两个版本的分界，解冲突时要一起删掉
parts.desc_en: The boundary between the upper and lower versions must be deleted together when resolving the conflict.

parts.desc: 被合进来的那条分支上这行长什么样
parts.desc_en: What does this line look like on the merged branch?

parts.desc: 冲突区到此为止，标着内容来自哪条分支
parts.desc_en: The conflict area ends here, marking which branch the content comes from.

variants.when: 目标分支没有独立的新提交
variants.when_en: The target branch has no independent new commits

variants.when: 两侧均有新提交，需要保留合并节点
variants.when_en: There are new commits on both sides and the merge node needs to be retained

variants.when: 需要放弃当前尚未完成的合并时
variants.when_en: When you need to abandon the current unfinished merge

use.t: 功能分支已经完成并通过测试后，再合回主版本
合并前先确认自己站在准备接收改动的分支上
出现冲突时逐处理解两边改动，再决定最终结果
合并完成后重新运行项目，确认两边功能仍然正常

dont.t: 没有确认当前分支就开始合并，导致改动进入错误位置
把冲突处理成只保留一边，却没有理解另一边的用途
冲突标记没有清理完整就保存版本
看到命令成功就结束，忘记重新运行和测试

lessonPractice.title: 功能分支准备进入 main，但两边都改了同一行。怎样处理冲突更可靠？

options.label: 理解两边意图后合并出正确内容，完成冲突标记，再运行相关测试
options.feedback: 对。冲突不是任选一边；需要保留正确业务结果并验证代码仍能运行。

options.label: 总是选择当前分支版本，因为它离自己最近
options.feedback: 当前分支不一定包含目标分支必须保留的修复。

options.label: 保留冲突标记提交，让 CI 之后再决定
options.feedback: 冲突标记不是可运行代码，应在合并前明确解决。

en.title: A feature branch is ready for main, but both sides changed one line. What is the reliable conflict handling?

options.label: Understand both intents, produce the correct combined content, clear markers, and run relevant tests
options.feedback: Correct. A conflict is not a choice of a side; retain the right behavior and verify it still runs.

options.label: Always choose the current branch because it is closest to your work
options.feedback: It may omit a required fix from the target branch.

options.label: Commit the conflict markers and let CI decide later
options.feedback: Conflict markers are not runnable code and need an explicit resolution first.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把这个功能分支合并到目标分支。先查看冲突两侧各自要保留什么，解决后确保没有冲突标记，再运行相关测试。完成后说明合并结果和测试结果，不要用“任选一边”的方式处理。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Merge this feature branch into its target. First inspect what each side must preserve, resolve the conflict, confirm no markers remain, and run relevant tests. Report the merge and test results; do not resolve it by arbitrarily choosing one side.

comparison.title: Git Merge 和 Rebase 有什么区别？
comparison.decision: 已共享的提交通常用 Merge 整合；尚未共享的个人分支可以在代码评审前用 Rebase 整理成线性历史。

dimensions.label: 提交历史
dimensions.current: 保留完整的分支分叉与汇合记录（快进合并时仅移动分支指针）
dimensions.other: 将当前分支的提交在目标基线上逐个重放，生成全新哈希的线性历史

dimensions.label: 协作安全
dimensions.current: 不改写已有提交 ID，更适合整合多人已经拉取的历史
dimensions.other: 会生成新的提交 ID；改写共享历史前必须与协作者明确协调

dimensions.label: 适用时机
dimensions.current: 合并功能分支到主干，或同步已经共享的团队分支
dimensions.other: 个人分支尚未共享，想在评审前整理历史或同步主干改动

scenario.title: 功能分支已有同事拉取协作
scenario.text: 同事已经基于你的分支继续开发时，Merge 是更稳妥的默认选择，因为不会改写他们已经拉取的提交。若分支还没有共享，可以在评审前 Rebase 到最新主干；共享后要重写历史，则需要先按团队约定协调。

comparison.title: Git merge vs rebase: which should you use?
comparison.decision: Use Merge as the safer default for shared commits. Consider Rebase on an unshared personal branch when you want a linear history before review.

dimensions.label: Commit history
dimensions.current: Preserves true branch history and explicit merge commits (or fast-forwards the branch pointer).
dimensions.other: Replays commits onto a new base, generating new commit hashes to produce a linear history.

dimensions.label: Collaboration
dimensions.current: Keeps existing commit IDs, making shared history easier to integrate.
dimensions.other: Creates new commit IDs; rewriting shared history requires explicit team coordination.

dimensions.label: When to use
dimensions.current: Merging a feature into main or integrating a shared team branch.
dimensions.other: Cleaning up an unshared personal branch or replaying it onto the latest main before review.

scenario.title: A feature branch with active collaborators
scenario.text: When teammates have already based work on your branch, Merge is the safer default because it does not rewrite commits they pulled. If the branch has not been shared, Rebase can place it on the latest main before review. Rewriting shared history should follow an explicit team agreement.
